t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The productivity of the knomes are not static and can get worse but usually bounce back after a few turns

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes picking speeds are not static, so they can fluctuate up and down, brown pointy gnome is very very unpredictable, sometimes he will pick 9 other times 0. use the 1x multipliers to work out if they are earning high at that point in time
